title: Safe Cleaning Habits When You Have Young Children
excerpt: Simple storage and cleaning habits for a home with little ones.
body:
Whatever products you use, a few simple habits make your home safer for children.

- Store cleaners up high or in a locked cupboard
- Keep products in their original labelled bottles
- Never pour cleaners into drink bottles
- Close caps straight after use
- Keep Ghana's emergency number (112) and your doctor's number handy

Read the label of every product before use, and follow its directions and warnings.
